newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine govt debt up at 1.146 trillion pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine govt debt up at 1.146 trillion pesos.

text.p: The Philippine government debt rose to 1.146 trillion pesos as of February this year, up from 1.141 trillion pesos registered by the end of the previous month, documents released by the finance department on Monday showed.
Foreign loans amounted to 404.678 billion pesos, while domestic debt stock was at 741.818 billion pesos.

The debt stock includes direct loans, such as government securities, loans to government agencies and government corporations, assumed loans and securitised loans including the Brady bonds and the Japanese yen bonds.
The Philippine government expects government debt to grow to 1.152 trillion pesos by the end of the year, from 1.132 billion pesos as of end-1996.
